title: ClearRun Honesty Verdict
description: The ONLY contract shared between the open ClearRun integration surface and the closed ClearRun scoring/governance kernel. The kernel (private) produces a Verdict; open packages (SDK, CLI, embed UI) consume it. No scoring logic, protocol internals, or governance state may cross this boundary — only the shape below.

verdictId.description: Opaque, stable identifier for this verdict (used for public verification lookups).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this verdict contract (semver). Current hosted responses use 1.2.0. Legacy receipts remain 1.0.0 or 1.1.0. Bumped only when the shared shape changes.

scoringVersion.description: Opaque version tag of the closed scoring kernel that produced this verdict. Present for Pro, Business, and Enterprise. Omitted on free, developer, and public responses. The formula behind it is not exposed.

score.description: Numeric honesty score 0-100, or null when UNDETERMINED / not configured. Score reflects confidence-justification alignment, never truth.

grade.description: Human-facing band label derived from the score. Never uses forbidden words (Correct/Safe/Approved/Trusted).

risk.description: Coarse risk tier for the evaluated response.

failureCategories.description: Enterprise responses only. Optional list of category strings. The names are not part of this public contract. Omitted on Pro, Business, free, developer, and public responses.

confidenceInterval.description: Uncertainty band around the score. Required by invariant H27 (scores must carry uncertainty bands). Present for Pro, Business, and Enterprise. Omitted on free, developer, and public responses. Null when score is null on older responses.

componentSignals.description: UI-safe component signals, pre-computed by the closed kernel for rendering component bars. Carries only a display level (0-6) and a short note, never protocol severity, weights, or formulas. Enterprise, Pro, and Business receive all four: Evidence support, Reasoning integrity, Confidence calibration, and Ambiguity handling. Free, developer, and public responses receive Evidence support and Reasoning integrity only.

level.description: Bar level 0-6 (6 = strongest). Already derived by the kernel.

note.description: Short public description of this component's state.

summary.description: Short, user-safe rationale (<= 16 words). Explains justification, not truth.

issues.description: Optional human-readable issue strings. Enterprise responses only. Omitted on other tiers.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the verdict was produced.

signature.description: Optional detached signature over the verdict payload, produced by the closed attestation service. Open packages VERIFY signatures; they never sign.

signatureKeyId.description: Identifier of the public key used to verify the signature.

signatureAlg.description: Signature algorithm (e.g. 'ed25519'). Present when signature is present.

signalsDigest.description: Coarse digest of the componentSignals included in the same response, on schema 1.1.0 and 1.2.0.

signalsSalt.description: Salt for signalsDigest. Paid owners may receive it. Public verify does not require it.
